WITH invoices_per_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
    FROM Invoices
    GROUP BY order_id
), shares AS (
    SELECT order_id, invoice_count,
           1.0 * invoice_count / SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM invoices_per_order
), above_average AS (
    SELECT invoice_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_number_of_invoices,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_over_average_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: The requested result is one aggregate row across the qualifying orders; the average share and average excess are computed over only orders whose share is strictly above the overall average.
